site_tagline: A host-side, multi-universe PDP-11 cross-development toolchain.
site_description: Build PDP-11 programs on a modern host — preprocess, compile, optimize, assemble, link — into real 2BSD a.out binaries, and run them unmodified under a user-mode PDP-11 UNIX simulator, faithfully across every era from the First Edition and Sixth and Seventh Editions through 2.11BSD, from one set of tools.
attribution: Software Architecture, Design & Engineering by Nicholas J. Kisseberth.

tools.name: pdp11-cc
tools.blurb: Runs cpp → c0 → c1 [→ c2 with -O] → as → ld in order and propagates the chosen universe to each pass. Ritchie's own cc, made cross and universe-aware.

tools.name: pdp11-cpp
tools.blurb: The pristine 2.9BSD cpp (Reiser lineage) — the one the PDP-11 cc was built against, and where an era's #ifdefs are dated.

tools.name: pdp11-c0
tools.blurb: Ritchie cc's front end: reads preprocessed C and writes the intermediate form the code generator consumes.

tools.name: pdp11-c1
tools.blurb: Ritchie cc's PDP-11 code generator: turns c0's intermediate form into assembly.

tools.name: pdp11-c2
tools.blurb: Ritchie cc's object-code improver, run over c1's assembly under -O.

tools.name: pdp11-as
tools.blurb: A C reimplementation of the 2BSD as, with historical --isa and --aout axes. It owns the operand tables das and apsim read, so all three agree about the machine.

tools.name: pdp11-ld
tools.blurb: The authentic 2.9BSD ld on an LP64 host: resolves, lays out and relocates into the era's native a.out — including the 0430/0431 auto-overlay formats.

tools.name: pdp11-xstr
tools.blurb: Bill Joy's 1978 xstr: pulls a C program's string literals into one shared strings file and hashes them.

tools.name: pdp11-libc
tools.blurb: A single libc.a and crt0 that serve every era: the universe is chosen at link (ld stamps __univ), crt0 records it, and the routines whose ABI moved branch on it at run time. Plus curses and termlib.

tools.name: pdp11-nm
tools.blurb: The symbol table of a.out objects, executables and archives.

tools.name: pdp11-size
tools.blurb: Text, data and bss sizes, and their sum, of a.out files.

tools.name: pdp11-das
tools.blurb: The inverse of as, covering every era the assembler does; it splits a symboled a.out into per-object listings and goes linear on a stripped one.

tools.name: pdp11-strip
tools.blurb: Removes the symbol table and relocation from an a.out — the 2.9BSD strip.

tools.name: pdp11-objcopy
tools.blurb: Copies an a.out, or extracts its loadable image (-O binary) or a single text/data segment (-j) — the a.out-only analogue of objcopy.

tools.name: pdp11-ar
tools.blurb: Authentic 2BSD ar, producing archives byte-identical to the originals.

tools.name: pdp11-ranlib
tools.blurb: Builds the __.SYMDEF table of contents in an archive, so ld resolves it in one pass.

tools.name: pdp11-apsim
tools.blurb: Interprets PDP-11 instructions and translates the guest's sys traps into host ones, in one process. Runs unmodified binaries across the whole lineage — First Edition through 2.11BSD — with auto-overlays, job control, sockets, a bit-exact FP11 softfloat and a real adb debug channel.
